details.eligibility: Bachelor's degree; age 20–37 years (Bihar rules; relaxations apply).
details.pattern: Prelims: 150 questions GS (2 hours, negative marking 0.25). Mains: Hindi (qualifying) + GS I, GS II + Essay + optional. Interview: 120 marks.
details.syllabus: Bihar GK, Polity, History, Geography, Economy, Current Affairs.
details.important_dates: 70th BPSC Prelims held 13 Dec 2024; re-exam for Patna centre 4 Jan 2025; Mains 25–30 Apr 2025.
